newsitem.title: THAILAND: Narongchai reappointed Thai commerce minister.
newsitem.headline: Narongchai reappointed Thai commerce minister.

text.p: Narongchai Akrasanee, who had tendered his resignation from the commerce ministerial portfolio, was reappointed to his post on Friday, the Government House announced.
Narongchai was reappointed to his post following the assent from King Bhumibol Adulyadej, it said.
Narongchai on Thursday tendered his resignation to Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh which would become effective from June 21.
